# data.docker_compose_containers

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the containers of a compose project, like `docker compose ps`, by the `com.docker.compose.project` label (one-off `run` containers excluded). Works for projects created by `docker_compose` and by the compose CLI.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | `bool` | optional |  |  | Include stopped containers (CLI `--all`). Default `false`: running containers only. |
| `container_ids` | `map(list(string))` | computed |  |  | Map of service name to the IDs of its selected containers, in container-number order. |
| `containers` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | The project's containers, ContainerSummary fields plus service/number from the compose labels. |
| `containers_json` | `string` | computed |  | yes | JSON array of the project's ContainerSummary objects (GET /containers/json, project label filter). Sensitive: Command can carry interpolated secrets. |
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | Hex SHA-256 of `containers_json`. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version of the daemon. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon. |
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | The compose project name (`com.docker.compose.project` label, CLI `--project-name`). |
| `services` | `list(string)` | optional |  |  | Only these services (default: every service of the project). |

## Example

```terraform
data "docker_compose_containers" "shop" {
  name = "shop"
  all  = true
}

output "states" {
  value = { for c in data.docker_compose_containers.shop.containers : c.names[0] => c.state }
}
```
